marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind light becoming north 15 knots this evening then diminishing
to light Thursday morning. Wind increasing to northwest 15 early Thursday
evening and to northwest 20 late Thursday evening. Scattered flurries. Visibility 1 mile or less in
flurries. Temperatures near plus 1. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early
Thursday evening.<br/>
